bead.title: bench-pr-A1a: harbor-runner Docker image + build-harbor-runner.sh content-sha label
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The Go runner forces the host to own a Python toolchain by prepending the repo root to Harbor's PYTHONPATH so Harbor can import scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.*. We want the host to need only bash + Node + Docker. Harbor and its Python agent plugins must move into a container image the host can `docker run`.

ROOT CAUSE: cmd/bench/matrix.go, runMatrixHarbor (the `// Add repo root to PYTHONPATH so harbor_adapters modules resolve.` block, ~lines 1117-1129) prepends opts.repoRoot to PYTHONPATH so scripts.benchmark.harbor_adapters.* resolve on the host. The Python plugins that must be containerized are scripts/benchmark/harbor_adapters/{claude.py,codex.py,opencode.py,pi.py} and scripts/benchmark/harbor_agent.py (FizeauAgent, harbor_agent.py:83). No host-independent runner image exists.

PROPOSED FIX:
- scripts/benchmark/Dockerfile.harbor-runner: FROM python:3.12-slim; pip install --no-cache-dir the pinned Harbor (5-min spike resolves the pin: PyPI `harbor==0.3.0`; confirm there is no separate `harbor-bench` package and that harbor_agent.py's 0.3.x BaseInstalledAgent API matches); COPY scripts/benchmark/harbor_adapters/ -> /app/harbor_adapters/ and scripts/benchmark/harbor_agent.py -> /app/harbor_agent.py; ENV PYTHONPATH=/app; WORKDIR /app; ENTRYPOINT ["harbor"].
- scripts/benchmark/build-harbor-runner.sh: docker build with --label image-content-sha=<sha256 over harbor_adapters/ + harbor_agent.py + Dockerfile.harbor-runner>, hashed deterministically (LC_ALL=C find | sort | per-file sha256) so a re-run with no source change yields the same label and a Docker-cache hit.
- ./benchmark preflight: rebuild the image iff the cached image's image-content-sha label != the freshly computed content sha; skip the rebuild when they match.

NON-SCOPE: shell harness-adapters + their listing/contract (sibling A1b); task-executors/harbor wrapper + its listing/contract (sibling A1c); runtime-probe.sh (sibling A1d); runner dispatch/--plan/matrix expansion (A2); per-cell execution loop, resume/retry, report compose (A3); concurrency/signals/budget (A4); Go changes, deactivation, parity (A5); cell-report.schema.json (PR B); tasks_from/task_executor bench-set schema (PR C); Node collector (PR D); Node importers (PR E); deleting cmd/bench (PR F); docs (PR G).

DEPENDENCY: parent fizeau-163efede. Foundation child — no sibling deps; sibling A1c and A2/A3/A5 depend on this image. Governing artifact: plan-2026-05-15-benchmark-runner-simplification.

ACCEPTANCE:
1. build-harbor-runner.sh builds fizeau-harbor-runner:latest with an image-content-sha label equal to sha256 of harbor_adapters/ + harbor_agent.py + Dockerfile.harbor-runner; a re-run with no source change is a cache hit (label unchanged). Test: Test_BuildLabelMatchesContentSha (scripts/benchmark/tests/build_label.bats).
2. ./benchmark preflight rebuilds the image iff the cached label differs from the current content sha. Test: Test_PreflightRebuildsOnShaChange (scripts/benchmark/tests/build_label.bats).
Gates: go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit both pass.
bead.acceptance: harbor-runner image builds with a content-sha label and preflight rebuilds only on sha change (Test_BuildLabelMatchesContentSha, Test_PreflightRebuildsOnShaChange); go test ./... and lefthook run pre-commit green.
